intro: In the Swamp of Sorrows, Dar says customers in Orgrimmar have a high demand for crawler meat, especially that of the monstrous crawlers. Dar asks you to bring back some of their legs from the coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There's a high demand for the succulent taste of crawler meat among my customers; especially the meat from the monstrous crawlers.
If you plan on heading to the coast, then I could easily make it worth your while to bring me back some of their legs to have transported back to Orgrimmar.
The coast is to the east from here, and you should have no problem finding the creatures scurrying along the beaches and under the sea.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have a cask of wine waiting for your success, friend. It's only right I taste the goods before I have it shipped back to my customers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this should be perfect. I can't wait to taste these after they are prepared perfectly over an open fire. You should take a sample of it with you on your travels. It truly is delicious.
